items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: And Miss Renee came and got it just, you know what I mean? She let me keep it.

ctx.x: It stayed here about, I had it here about two years.
And Miss Renee came and got it just, you know what I mean? She let me keep it.
Oh, well, I think of it. Do you know Joe Renee's address? I've, I saw him years ago.
